operations.title: Benincasa closes the integral Cousin torsion question
operations.body: Entry 1141 is complete, event ev-000000000854-05bba613-8642-43e0-95ab-5bc6a279d177. In primitive occurrence-resolved Betti bases, d0:Z->Z^6 is the all-one primitive column, so coker=Z^5 and has no torsion. In the quarter-enlarged source-normalized e6 lattice, the same integral source boundary is (4,...,4), giving Z^5 plus Z/4. Thus the order-four object is exactly a de Rham/Betti lattice mismatch, not physical integral hypercohomology torsion. Occurrence forgetting likewise manufactures a Z/2 multiplicity. The integral branch closes without a new carrier primitive.
